title: Honey Garlic Chicken with Broccoli Rice
description: A sweet, sticky and spicy honey garlic chicken packed with flavour, served with broccoli rice.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Dice the broccoli into 1–2cm pieces. Cook the rice following pack instructions. Season with salt and add the broccoli 5 minutes before the end.
Thinly slice the spring onions. Dice the chicken into 2–3cm pieces. Mix garlic powder, chilli powder, flour and a pinch of salt.
Toss the chicken in the mix, transfer to a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil. Roast 15–20 minutes until cooked through.
Mince the garlic and mix with gochujang, soy sauce and honey. Pour over the chicken and roast another 5–10 minutes until sticky. Season with lime juice.
Plate the broccoli rice, top with sticky chicken and remaining sauce. Scatter spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Curried Coconut Chicken & Rice
description: Tangy Thai-inspired chicken in a coconut curry broth, ladled over rice.
steps: Put the chicken in a bowl. Grate over the garlic, stir through half the oyster sauce, season and set aside. Pick the coriander and thinly chop the stalks.

Heat a saucepan over medium-high heat. Add a splash of coconut milk, then coriander stalks, curry paste and remaining oyster sauce until fragrant. Add water and remaining coconut milk, boil, then simmer 10–15 minutes.
Fry the marinated chicken in a little oil until charred and cooked through. Season the broth with lime juice, salt, sugar and pepper.
Divide rice between bowls, ladle over the soup, top with sliced chicken, chilli oil, crispy onions, coriander and a lime wedge.

title: Juicy Pulled Chipotle Chicken
description: Smoky, spicy pulled chicken that is ridiculously juicy. Pile into tacos, rice bowls or toasties.
steps: Finely dice the onion, grate the garlic and thinly slice the peppers.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan. Cook onion and peppers 5–7 minutes until soft, then add garlic, coriander, cumin, chipotle paste and tomato purée. Cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken thighs whole and pour in the stock. Season. Simmer 30–35 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Shred the chicken in the pan with two forks and stir through the smoky sauce. Season to taste.

title: Sausage Gochujang Rigatoni
description: Sweet, fiery sausage pasta with gochujang, cream, honey and lime. A weeknight hero.
steps: Mince the shallot and garlic. Heat oil, squeeze sausage meat from the skins and fry until well browned. Deglaze with a splash of water. Set the sausage aside.
Melt butter, fry shallot and garlic until soft. Add gochujang, cream, honey and juice of half the limes. Grate in most of the Parmesan, return the sausage and simmer.
Boil the rigatoni in salted water until al dente. Reserve pasta water.
Fry breadcrumbs in oil until golden, then mix with remaining Parmesan and some coriander.
Toss pasta through the sauce with a ladle of pasta water until glossy. Finish with coriander, breadcrumbs and lime zest.

title: Spicy Salmon Bowl with Sesame Rice & Soy Butter
description: Flaky salmon over sesame rice with a glossy soy butter, greens and chilli.
steps: Cook the rice with a pinch of salt. Stir through sesame oil and sesame seeds when fluffy.
Season the salmon. Pan-fry skin-side down until crisp, then flip and cook until just opaque.
Steam or pan the broccoli until tender. Slice spring onions and chilli.
Melt butter with grated garlic and ginger, then stir in soy and honey until glossy.
Bowl up sesame rice, broccoli and salmon. Spoon over soy butter, chilli, spring onion and lime.

title: High Protein Smashed Cucumber & Chilli Chicken
description: Cold smashed cucumber and chilli oil tossed with leftover or quick-cooked chicken. Fifteen minutes, huge flavour.
steps: Bash the cucumber until it splits, then chop into chunks. Sprinkle with salt and leave 5 minutes, then drain.
Shred the chicken. Slice spring onions and pick coriander.
Mix garlic, chilli oil, soy, vinegar and sugar.
Toss cucumber and chicken with the dressing. Top with sesame, spring onion and coriander.

title: Minced Beef & Broccoli Stir Fry
description: Sweet, savoury and packed with umami. Sticky beef stir-fry that comes together in minutes.
steps: Cook the rice. Mix sauce ingredients: water, both soys, oyster sauce, sugar, white pepper and cornflour.
Mince garlic and ginger. Cut broccoli into florets and slice spring onions.
Microwave broccoli with a splash of water for 3 minutes until just tender, or blanch 2 minutes.
Stir-fry beef mince in a hot wok 3–4 minutes. Add ginger and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add broccoli and sauce. Toss 2–3 minutes until thick and glossy. Finish with sesame oil, seeds and spring onions.

title: Marry Me Chicken Pasta Bake
description: Creamy, spicy, cheesy pasta bake with cottage cheese, sun-dried tomato and gochujang.
steps: Boil the pasta until al dente. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and tear the basil. Slice or shred the chicken.
Blend cottage cheese, sun-dried tomato paste, gochujang, garlic powder and a splash of pasta water until smooth.
Toss pasta, chicken, tomatoes and basil with the sauce. Loosen with more pasta water if needed.
Tip into an ovenproof dish, grate over Parmesan and grill 5–10 minutes until bubbling.

title: Chicken & Basil Stir Fry
description: Fast Thai-style chicken stir-fry with garlic, chilli and plenty of basil.
steps: Cook the rice. Bash garlic, chilli and shallot to a rough paste.
Heat oil in a wok until smoking. Fry the paste a few seconds, then add chicken mince and break it up until cooked.
Add oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce and sugar. Toss until sticky.
Take off the heat and fold through basil until wilted. Serve with rice and a fried egg if you like.

title: Piri Piri Chicken & Herby Lemon Chickpeas
description: Smoky piri piri chicken on creamy, lemony chickpeas. Fresh, fiery and full of protein.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Bash the chicken to about 1cm thick. Drizzle with half the oil, piri piri seasoning, salt and pepper. Bake about 12 minutes until cooked, then slice.
Slice garlic and chilli. Peel a few strips of lemon zest.
Heat remaining oil, fry garlic until golden, then fennel seeds and chilli for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas with their liquid, lemon zest, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Off the heat, stir through yoghurt, most of the parsley and lemon juice. Serve chicken on the creamy chickpeas with extra parsley.

title: Sweet Potato, Minced Beef & Cottage Cheese Bowl
description: Crispy sweet potato, taco-spiced beef and a cooling dollop of cottage cheese, drizzled with hot honey.
steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato. Spray with oil, season, and air-fry at 200°C for 16–18 minutes (or roast at 180°C for 30 minutes).
Brown the mince 6–7 minutes, then stir in taco seasoning and a pinch of salt.
Halve the tomatoes and shred the lettuce.
Bowl up sweet potato, cottage cheese and taco beef. Add lettuce, tomatoes and pickled onions.
Drizzle with hot honey and finish with chilli flakes.

title: Creamy Garlic & Herby Chicken Gnocchi
description: Soft gnocchi in a garlicky herb cream with golden chicken. Comforting and quick.
steps: Season chicken and pan-fry in oil until golden and cooked. Rest, then slice.
In the same pan, melt butter and fry garlic and thyme until fragrant.
Add gnocchi and fry a couple of minutes. Pour in stock and cream, simmer until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce thickens.
Stir through spinach, Parmesan, lemon juice and most of the parsley. Fold in the chicken.
Serve with extra Parmesan and parsley.

title: Weeknight Chicken Gyros
description: Crispy marinated chicken, cool tzatziki and fries in a warm flatbread. A fakeaway wrap in a flash.
steps: Grate two-thirds of the garlic. Mix with chicken, half the yoghurt, onion powder, paprika, cumin, oregano, zest and juice of half the lemon, salt and pepper. Marinate.
Grate cucumber, squeeze dry, and mix with remaining yoghurt, remaining lemon juice, last garlic clove and salt for tzatziki.
Slice tomato and red onion. Cook fries and chicken in an air fryer at 200°C for 15–20 minutes (or oven 25–30 minutes at 220°C).
Toast the flatbreads. Spread tzatziki, add tomato, onion, sliced chicken, parsley and fries, then wrap.

title: Caramelised Soy Chicken in Garlic Ginger Broth
description: Sticky soy chicken sitting in a fragrant garlic-ginger broth with rice.
steps: Cook the rice. Mix soy sauces and honey. Slice garlic, ginger and spring onions.
Sear chicken in oil until browned. Pour in most of the soy mix and caramelise 2–3 minutes. Set aside.
In the same pan, fry garlic and ginger, then add stock and remaining soy. Simmer 8 minutes.
Add pak choi to wilt. Return chicken to warm through. Finish with sesame oil and spring onions. Serve over rice.

title: “Marry Me” Chicken Orzo
description: Chicken and orzo in a creamy sun-dried tomato and pesto sauce. Make this and you’ll understand the title.
steps: Dice the onion and chicken. Slice sun-dried tomatoes and crush the garlic.
Heat sun-dried tomato oil in a deep pan. Soften onion and garlic, then cook the chicken about 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes, oregano, thyme, pesto, salt and pepper. Pour in about 90% of the stock and bring to the boil.
Stir in orzo, simmer about 7 minutes until mostly absorbed but still a little loose. Add remaining stock if needed.
Stir in cream and cook 3 minutes more. Finish with torn basil and Parmesan.

title: Greek Gnocchi Traybake
description: All the flavours of a Greek salad in a warm traybake. The oven does most of the work.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Whisk lemon zest, half the lemon juice, grated garlic, olive oil, oregano, harissa, salt and pepper.
Halve tomatoes and dice aubergine. Toss with oil, salt and pepper. Roast 15 minutes.
Slice red onion and pickle in remaining lemon juice with a pinch of salt.
Add drained lentils, gnocchi and olives to the tray. Pour over the harissa dressing and roast 10 minutes.
Crumble over feta and roast 5 minutes more. Serve with parsley, pickled onions and a drizzle of oil.
